researcher_direction: 请核查准备包，补齐可断点恢复的生成执行器及官方评分执行、回收与分析流程，在冻结 A6000 可用后推进本地生成。
新官方评分拟议的 $15 尚未批准。先完成执行器、真实评分请求和费用清单，再就具体付费批次确认。
不要停止其他项目的 GPU 任务；设备忙时继续完成不依赖 GPU 的工作。

scope.local_generation: Execute the already prepared 1,924 natural-end Generator requests of static_sample_20260917_v1 on the frozen Llama-3.1-8B stack. Free, local, resumable. One shared true-OFF response per target, already structural in the package.
scope.offline_binding: Bind completed responses to exact official scorer payloads and produce a real cost manifest from observed prediction lengths.
scope.paid_scoring: NOT authorized by this record. A separate researcher approval naming the stage cap must set new_paid_execution_authorized.
scope.analysis: Recovery, completeness auditing and missingness reporting are authorized. Producing fold-external k recommendations additionally requires the RQ2 memory amount-calibration authorization flag below.

outcome_locks_unchanged.note: Local generation produces predictions, not calibration outcomes. The executors assert every scoped lock is still CLOSED before running and never edit the config.

gpu_policy.device_selection: CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1; verify the visible device reports NVIDIA RTX A6000 before loading.
gpu_policy.other_project_jobs: KVCacheNet processes of another project may occupy the A6000. Never stop, signal, or contend with them, and never silently move the frozen Generator to different hardware.
gpu_policy.on_insufficient_memory: Exit without loading the model and report the observed free memory; do not fall back to another GPU or to CPU.

natural_end.max_new_tokens: native context minus complete input; never truncate evidence
natural_end.guard_handling: Timeout, exact-cycle interruption and context exhaustion are recorded as separate incomplete outcomes; never a complete answer, never a zero score, never semantic uncertainty.

resume_rules.identity: request_sha256 of the prepared package row must match a cached response or the run stops.
resume_rules.no_duplicate_generation: A cached response is never regenerated; a cached response whose identity disagrees is a hard error, not an overwrite.
resume_rules.failed_attempts: Every start and every failure is appended to attempts.jsonl before and after the attempt.

official_scorer_parity.prompts: unchanged upstream SystemMessage/HumanMessage bytes rendered from the AST-extracted templates
official_scorer_parity.parsers: upstream QA first-[0-2] regex and upstream Summary json_repair plus integer count formulas

vendored_json_repair.reason: Reproduce the official Summary parser without modifying the frozen Generator environment.
